candidate_states.description: For the disputed one-port closed region, the entire visibly closed region can serve as the free endpoint without an invented internal path.
For the disputed region, a route that only reaches the opaque entry boundary does not yet certify an upper direct free-ending T.

potential_global_variable.meaning: Candidate readings of the frozen language, not newly approved universal inclusion/exclusion rules. Both require actual visibility evidence; neither says all caps always qualify or always fail.

F03.mapping_scope: Only the three explicitly disputed upper caps and two named parent motifs. This does NOT supply a complete interpretation-conditioned mapping of all side/red remainder.

unmapped_or_partially_mapped_scope.scope: Selected tapered continuous green routes do not assert passage through an independently outlined opaque cap; remaining motifs are not exhaustively mapped under a common endpoint convention.
Incoming/upper continuity at U03 is locally damaged. Existing C1/C2/C3 encode that visibility issue, not a completed mapping of the potential global endpoint convention across all terminal regions.
R03_side_regions remains unallocated, even though upper U04/U05 have an explicit coupled case map.
Selected units are downstream Q0 and local J only; no upper T classification was inferred. A04_endpoint_scope and remaining filled-region roles have no per-state mapping.
Selected T endpoints are actual exposed black ink tips, not proxies for closed opaque regions. The remaining filled side-region hierarchy is unallocated.
No fixed counted C-Z/J witnesses; fine visibility and filled-region endpoint interpretation remain unresolved together. No per-state map supplied.

cross_entry_constraints.no_shared_physical_entity_claim: The six fixed entries are distinct drawn entities. Shared manuscript/image provenance is a dependence but does not make their motifs the same physical variable.
cross_entry_constraints.coupling_reason: F03 explicitly retains an endpoint-boundary reading with an operational-convention component. The package cannot honestly recast every such choice as independent pixel noise. Uniform whole-six conditioning has not been established.
cross_entry_constraints.required_before_true_scoring: Root must either define and audit a complete outer-case mapping that preserves this constraint within the frozen scientific scope, or report numerical execution/operability incomplete. Observer does not approve scores or a new rule.

cross_entry_constraint_scope: A nonempty potential global interpretation constraint is retained. It is not legitimate to send an empty array merely to satisfy the existing Cartesian-product scoring entry point.
